title: Cell Culture Preparation with CSV Input
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Parse CSV and select wells
steps.instruction: Load the CSV file, identify wells whose confluency value exceeds 85, and record those wells for later actions; if multiple qualifying wells are in the same column, plan to use a multi‑channel pipette and pick up only the required number of tips, with tip replacement available if needed.

steps.title: Configure temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module to the user‑specified temperature in degrees Celsius before any liquid handling.

steps.title: Set pipette parameters
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 single‑channel pipette on the specified side (left or right), enable tip tracking if requested, set the first‑step waste aspiration rate to the chosen value (default 1.0, 1.5 for 50 % faster, 0.2 for 20 % of default), and set the PBS dispense flow rate to the chosen value (default 1.0, 1.5 for 50 % faster, 0.2 for 20 % of default).

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Confirm that each reservoir well contains at least 3 mL of reagent before starting and that the protocol will never leave more than 3 mL of any reagent in a reservoir at any point (i.e., maintain ≥3 mL after completion).

steps.title: Transfer 200 µL to waste
steps.instruction: Aspirate 200 µL from each selected well (confluency >85) and dispense into the waste container using the previously set aspiration rate.

steps.title: Add 150 µL PBS
steps.instruction: Dispense 150 µL of PBS into each selected well, positioning the tip 2 mm from the side of the well to avoid separation of the culture, using the configured PBS dispense flow rate.

steps.title: Remove 175 µL PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate 175 µL of PBS from each selected well and discard to waste.

steps.title: Add trypsin
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 µL of trypsin to each selected well.

steps.title: Incubate after trypsin
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for the user‑specified incubation time (minutes) after adding trypsin.

steps.title: Add first media
steps.instruction: Transfer 140 µL of the first media to each selected well (or use the user‑specified Media Aspirate X volume if different).

steps.title: Aspirate media to waste
steps.instruction: Aspirate the volume defined as Media Aspirate X (µL) from each selected well and dispense to waste.

steps.title: Dispense second media
steps.instruction: Dispense the volume defined as Media Dispense Y (µL) of second media onto each selected well.
